enable_api.description: Enable or disable the Icinga 2 API endpoint.

api_bind_host.description: IP address the API listens on (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

api_bind_port.description: Port number for the Icinga 2 API endpoint.

enable_notifications.description: Enable or disable notification processing (e.g., for alerting).

command_endpoint.description: Default endpoint where remote commands (e.g., from Icinga Director) are sent.

event_buffer_max_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) of buffered events before they are purged.

event_buffer_max_items.description: Maximum number of buffered events before overflow occurs.

zones.description: List of distributed monitoring zones. Each zone can define a parent zone and endpoints.

parent_zone.description: Optional name of the parent zone (for hierarchical zones).

endpoints.description: List of endpoint names assigned to this zone.
List of endpoint definitions (hostname + port) used in distributed monitoring.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of this endpoint.

port.description: Port number for the Icinga 2 API on this endpoint.

features.description: Map of feature names to boolean (or string 'enabled'/'disabled') values. Common: 'IDO', 'Graphite', 'InfluxDB', 'Syslog'.
